scope: Four explicit typed addresses, four categorical contents, ten physical/recovery phases, six fixed-deadline queries. Synthetic finite CTMC mechanism and decision study. Routing is supplied identically, not learned semantic addressing. No production activation or continuum optimality claim.
question: Does retained conditional state change valuable actions once address binding is reliable, and does HX improve over a matched ordinary generator/HMM after full cost?
initial_content: Random permutation of four values over four explicit keys. Source phase sampled independently. Public WRITE reveals content only.
overwrite: At query indices 2 and 4, publicly overwrite one key preserving its current latent phase. Previous deadline is observed/scored before the next WRITE.
distractors: One typed distractor per query start, routed through the shared event interface and never treated as a WRITE.

observations.read: active: correct .70, three alternatives .10; recovery: erasure
observations.refresh: correct .97, three alternatives .01 in every phase

actions.STOP: Submit forecast for fixed deadline; all states then propagate to that deadline.
actions.READ: One time slot; only then observe the query address.
actions.REFRESH: Two slots; only then obtain an independently keyed higher quality observation.

reward: Mean across six fixed-deadline correctness rewards minus actual observation/active-time fees. The four arms share the same entire world tape and target times.

calibration.method: L-BFGS-B on observed raw sequence likelihood. Two HX parameters and four free-rate parameters; all attempts charged.
calibration.shared_model_hmm: Same fitted HX matrices, full charge of reused calibration, structural equivalence reference.

ordinary_selection: Choose free-generator HMM or same-HX-matrix HMM using actual validation task net utility under the common value controller. Retain both results. Calibration loglik selection is a separate diagnostic.
light_control_selection: Choose one fixed action sequence by pooled HX and selected-ordinary validation utility. Freeze it for both A and C.
learned_policy: One-action READ/REFRESH then STOP ridge policies fit on realized paired returns at fixed-STOP training prefixes. Four predeclared feature sets. They are not trained Q-star or unrestricted Q-pi controllers.

primary_arms.B: same selected ordinary + shared finite-deadline controller

mechanism_scope: Factorized, index-mean and memoryless recovery interventions keep fitted parameters and inputs fixed; they are descriptive same-weight sensitivities, not retrained necessity proofs. Ordinary dual uses the same feature count as value+risk.
controller_scope: Exact enumeration only within the current query's three slots under its supplied finite model. Does not optimize information value for future queries. No continuous QVI or smooth-pasting guarantee.

statistics.primary: D-B mean utility IID and OOD, exhaustive two-sided sign flip and Holm across two domains
statistics.ci: Student t with seven degrees of freedom; seed is the replicate
statistics.secondary: descriptive, no primary rescue or causal necessity claim
statistics.quality_noninferiority_ci: Four one-sided 98.75% Student-t lower bounds (utility/reward x IID/OOD), Bonferroni family alpha .05.
statistics.quality_gain_gate: Both domains must separately meet minimum mean .01, t95 lower >0 and Holm-adjusted two-sided sign-flip p<.05.
statistics.quality_cost_gate: All four simultaneous noninferiority lower bounds >-.01 and both domains measured online plus whole-search-at-1000-episode-reuses CPU ratio D/B <=.90.

cost_scope: Record all calibration candidates, validation/controller fitting, cold construction, all hypothetical planner branches, online execution, checkpoint serialization and file roundtrips, shared world generation, worker startup/import/final writes. Report whole-search/standalone/equal-calibration and reuse 1/100/1000/10000. Simulated task fees are separate from measured CPU seconds.
source_freeze: Publish exact source/protocol before formal training. Publish all fitted candidates and selections with hashes before first confirmation generation. No source/model/threshold changes after confirmation is opened.
channel_feature_scope: Base is phase-index mean plus content confidence/time/prices/entropy, not literal V-Vb. The value feature is terminal STOP forecast, not original financial equity or optimal continuation. Risk is next natural first passage. Common feature-work is charged to every learned-policy variant.
checkpoint_scope: Belief/model/clock checkpoint with checksum and local fsync/read/restore, not full owner crash recovery or network transport.
active_time_scope: Synthetic active action duration tariff .003; STOP padding is free, so this is not all physical delay or measured energy.
seeds_scope: Calibration 11m/21m plus fit seed; episode namespaces phase_id*10^12 + fit_seed*10^5 + domain_offset + index. Phase policy=1 selection=2 confirmation=3; OOD offset=10000.
ood_scope: Only observation/query intervals change; the latent law, observation kernels and price scale distribution remain the same. This is temporal extrapolation, not cross-family or real-world OOD.
